title: Convergence of Practical Muon with Finite Newton-Schulz Iterations and Nesterov Momentum
abstract: arXiv:2609.39595v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Practical Muon maintains momentum and performs a small, fixed number of Newton--Schulz iterations separately for each parameter matrix, often with a Nesterov correction. We analyze these layer-wise finite-step updates jointly on a coupled nonconvex objective, rather than replacing them by exact polar factors or one global orthogonalization. Under gradient-dependent $(\mathcal L_0,\mathcal L_1,q)$-smoothness and conditionally unbiased stochastic gradients with bounded layer-wise variance, we establish an $\mathcal O(T^{-1/4})$ bound on the expected average Frobenius gradient norm. The analysis retains the Nesterov recursion and requires neither bounded stochastic gradients, symmetric noise, nor a uniform positive lower bound on the nonzero output singular values. translated_title: 基于有限Newton-Schulz迭代与Nesterov动量的实用Muon优化器的收敛性分析
translated_abstract: 实用Muon优化器为每个参数矩阵维护动量，并对每个矩阵分别执行少量固定次数的Newton-Schulz迭代，通常还结合Nesterov校正。我们在一个耦合的非凸目标上对这类逐层的有限步更新进行联合分析，而不是用精确的极因子或单一的全局正交化来替代这些操作。在依赖梯度的 $\((\mathcal L_0,\mathcal L_1,q)$\)-光滑性以及具有有界逐层方差的条件无偏随机梯度假设下，我们建立了期望平均Frobenius梯度范数的 $\(\mathcal O(T^{-1/4})$\)$ 界。该分析保留了Nesterov递归结构，且既不要求随机梯度有界、噪声对称，也不要求非零输出奇异值具有一致的正下界。当块数和问题常数固定时，收敛界的常数中不包含显式的矩阵维度或秩因子。证明过程基于一个下降不等式和一个分解方法。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次对实用Muon优化器的逐层有限次Newton-Schulz迭代与Nesterov动量在耦合非凸目标上进行了联合收敛性分析，在依赖梯度的光滑性与有界方差条件下证明了 O(T^{-1/4}) 的收敛界，且无需随机梯度有界、噪声对称或奇异值正下界等限制性假设，收敛界常数中也不含显式的矩阵维度或秩因子。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first joint convergence analysis of the practical Muon optimizer—retaining per-layer finite Newton–Schulz iterations and Nesterov momentum—on a coupled nonconvex objective, establishing an O(T^{-1/4}) bound under gradient-dependent smoothness and bounded-variance conditions, without requiring bounded stochastic gradients, symmetric noise, or singular-value lower bounds, and with constants free of explicit matrix-dimension or rank factors.
